title: Run OpenBSD on DigitalOcean for $4/month
summary: A practical guide showing how to deploy and run OpenBSD on DigitalOcean's $4/month cloud VPS, bypassing DigitalOcean's lack of official OpenBSD support through custom installation methods.
problem_solved: Enables users to run OpenBSD on affordable cloud infrastructure where it's not officially supported
why_valuable: Provides a cost-effective ($4/month) way to leverage OpenBSD's security and simplicity in a cloud environment, benefiting developers seeking a secure self-hosted setup
